title: DAF 2020 CF (Euro 6) polished custom alloy Bullbar #3
description: DAF CF 2020 Euro 6 Polished Hi-Tensile Aluminium Custom Bull Bar, features heavy duty box uprights for maximum protection plus dual centre mini uprights for additional protection. 76mm diameter high tensile aluminium tubing with pressed high tensile main channel, the two main cross tubes are one piece and pass fully through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. High tensile aluminium backing plate, (saves 70Kg) with 38mm tow pin. Recessed lights in main channel and driving light mounts to customer specification. The bullbar can be customised to suit your application.
